# jamfplatform_device_unmanage (Action)

Removes remote management from a device. Requires **Device Management Actions API access**.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "jamfplatform_device_unmanage" "retire_device" {
  config {
    device_id = "uuid-of-device-to-unmanage"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device_id` (String) Jamf Pro Management ID. Provide this or `serial_number`.
- `serial_number` (String) Device serial number (case-sensitive). Requires **Device Inventory API access** when used. Provide this or `device_id`.
